$comment: webapp-capture-stinger config. Copy to the target repo (for example library/design/capture.config.json) and edit. Paths are relative to the config file unless absolute.

app.name: Example App
app.context: One sentence describing what the app is and who uses it. Fed to the describe and merge prompts.

auth.$comment: A human logs in once in a visible window (scripts/save-session.mjs). The agent never types credentials.

onboarding.$comment: Optional explicitly approved local or seeded onboarding preflight. Screenshots each step before executing its declared actions. Disabled by default.

theme.$comment: Optional: force a theme the app stores client-side. Leave localStorage null if prefers-color-scheme is enough. verifySelector must match when the theme is active, or capture refuses to run.

routes.$comment: discover: nav-links | crawl-links | list. crawl-links recursively follows same-origin anchors up to maxRoutes.

tabs.$comment: Tabs that change settings or only filter data are not tabs. Add their routes to noTabsOnRoutes after the first dry run.

redact.$comment: Recursive redaction covers every exported metadata string/key and URI value. Configure app-specific patterns and pixel masks. Pixels require explicit selectors; review every shared screenshot/video.

network.$comment: Reads default to GET/HEAD/OPTIONS. Each approved JSON POST read needs method POST, kind rest-read or graphql-query, exact same-origin path and SHA256 of actual UTF-8 request bytes. Redirects, WebSockets and service workers are refused.
